quote: a retention of six percent by way of Security Deposits, until the amount of Security Deposit by way of such retentions shall amount to 5% of the total value of the contract
notes: Six percent is retained from on-account payments by way of Security Deposit until the retentions reach 5% of the total value of the contract (46(1)). Clause 16(1) sets the Security Deposit at 5% of contract value, counts the Bid Security towards it, and lets the balance be paid in cash, TDR or bank guarantee instead of being recovered at 6% of the bill amount. Refund comes after final payment, the final supplementary agreement and the Maintenance Certificate (16(2), PDF p57). For a defaulting Contractor the Railway may hold amounts so that the total held, including the Performance Guarantee, does not exceed 10% of contract value (p56).

quote: This shall be limited to 10% of the Contract value and shall be paid in 2 stages : Stage 1– 5% of Contract Value on signing of the contract agreement. Stage 2 – 5% on mobilization of site-establishment, setting up offices, bringing in equipment and actual commencement of work.
notes: Applies only if the tender documents provide for advances. The mobilisation advance is limited to 10% of contract value, paid in two stages of 5% (on signing the agreement, then on mobilisation after a utilisation certificate). It is interest-bearing (the rate is not stated in this document) and needs a guarantee of at least 110% (PDF p77). A separate advance against machinery is limited to 10% of contract value and 75% of the equipment price (p77). Recovery runs from the point where 15% of the work is executed until 85% (p77). A diverted advance carries 15% a year interest.

If the Railway is not satisfied the work can be completed, it may take the Security Deposit and rescind the contract under clause 62.

quote: Price Variation Clause (PVC) shall be applicable only in tender having advertised value above Rs. 2 Crores and having completion period above 12 months.
notes: A Price Variation Clause exists but applies only to tenders with advertised value above Rs 2 crore AND completion period above 12 months (46A.1). The base month is one month before tender closing, the variation is worked out quarterly on the average price index, and fixed components are excluded (46A.2 to 46A.5). Rates otherwise hold until completion (46A.3). The component percentages are set in the tender documents, not here.

quote: The successful bidder shall submit the Performance Guarantee (PG) in any of the following forms, amounting to 5% of the original contract value
notes: A Performance Guarantee of 5% of the ORIGINAL contract value (it does not change with later variations, 16(4)(d)), submitted within 21 days of the Letter of Acceptance (up to 60 days with penal interest of 12% a year after day 21, 16(4)(a)). It is a separate item from the 5% Security Deposit in clause 16(1). Valid until the stipulated completion date plus 60 days and released after physical completion (16(4)(e), PDF p58).
